title: Integrative Identification of Anti-Photoaging Peptides From Stress-Tolerant Microorganisms via Machine Learning and KEAP1-NRF2 Docking.
authors: Lee, Hanui; Jeong, Gyeong Han; Choi, Ji Wan; Kim, Taehwan; Shin, Younhee; Lim, Jaewon; Jung, Kwang-Woo; Chung, Byung Yeoup; Lee, Seung Sik
journal: Journal of peptide science : an official publication of the European Peptide Society
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习与KEAP1-NRF2对接筛选抗光老化肽，对象为蛋白-肽互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴，与课题关联弱。
abstract: Excess reactive oxygen species generated by ultraviolet exposure cause photoaging by degrading collagen and inhibiting its synthesis. This study presents a comprehensive strategy connecting the biological stress responses of gamma-irradiated microorganisms to the discovery of novel anti-photoaging peptides. We profiled the radiation-regulated transcriptomes of Deinococcus radiodurans and Cryptococcus neoformans, focusing on DNA repair and oxidative stress responses. From these datasets, peptide libraries were generated in silico, filtered for biochemical properties, and prioritized using a seven-classifier machine-learning algorithm. Structural validity was established using Rosetta FlexPepDocking against the KEAP1-NRF2 pocket, which identified 48 docking-positive sequences. We then synthesized the top 21 peptides and subjected them to in vitro validation. Seven of these candidate peptides inhibited collagenase activity at 200 muM. Among them, four peptides dose-dependently increased the procollagen type I C-peptide level in ultraviolet B-induced fibroblasts. Furthermore, these peptides significantly elevated COL1A1 mRNA levels while simultaneously reducing MMP1 and MMP9 transcript and protein levels. In summary, this study provides an integrated strategy that combines omics, machine learning, and docking to discover promising peptide candidates, which were validated through in vitro assessments. This approach offers promising anti-photoaging candidates that can be applied to other oxidative stress pathways and biological resources.
abstract_zh: 紫外线暴露产生的过量活性氧通过降解胶原蛋白并抑制其合成导致光老化。本研究提出了一种综合策略，将γ辐照微生物的生物应激反应与新型抗光老化肽的发现联系起来。我们分析了耐辐射奇球菌（Deinococcus radurans）和新型隐球菌（Cryptococcus neoformans）的辐射调控转录组，重点关注DNA修复和氧化应激反应。从这些数据集中，通过计算机模拟生成肽库，过滤生化特性，并使用七分类器机器学习算法进行优先级排序。利用Rosetta FlexPepDocking针对KEAP1-NRF2口袋建立结构有效性，鉴定出48个对接阳性序列。随后，我们合成了排名前21的肽，并进行体外验证。其中七种候选肽在200 μM浓度下抑制胶原酶活性。在这些肽中，四种以剂量依赖性方式增加了紫外B诱导的成纤维细胞中I型前胶原C肽水平。此外，这些肽显著提高了COL1A1 mRNA水平，同时降低了MMP1和MMP9的转录本和蛋白水平。总之，本研究提供了一种整合策略，结合组学、机器学习和对接来发现 promising 的肽候选物，并通过体外评估进行验证。该方法为其他氧化应激途径和生物资源提供了有前景的抗光老化候选物。
